claims.claim: $54.59B Cost of War Toxic Exposures Fund ... The Cost of War Toxic Exposures Fund is funded at $54.59B.
claims.sourceSpan: $54,593,000,000, to remain available until expended; and, in addition, $53,715,000,000, which shall become available on October 1, 2027, and shall remain available until September 30, 2029.
claims.note: Understates the fund. The bill provides $54.59B available now PLUS a separate $53.72B advance appropriation for FY2028; the analysis reports only the first tranche while elsewhere labeling comparable advance accounts. Total provision to the fund is roughly double the figure given.
